profile.title: Your profile
profile.lead: Your account details, your uploads, and the forms to change your username, email or password.

uploads.title: Your uploads
uploads.lead: Every prompt you posted or co-author, newest first.

username.title: Change your username
username.lead: Your posts, reviews and comments show the new @username at once. You can change it once every 30 days, and your old name becomes free for anyone.
username.nextChange: You changed your username recently. You can change it again on {date}.

errors.tooSoon: You changed your username less than 30 days ago. Try again later.
errors.usernameRequired: Pick a username first. Reload the page to continue.

email.title: Change your email
email.lead: We send a confirmation link to the new address. Your email changes once you open it; until then you keep signing in with {email}.
email.checkEmail: Almost done: we sent a link to {email}. Open it to confirm the change. If we also emailed your current address, open that link too.

errors.emailTaken: Another account already uses this email.

password.title: Change your password
password.lead: Type your current password first, so nobody can change it from a session you left open.
password.saved: Your password has changed. Use the new one next time you sign in.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session has ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.notConfigured: Accounts aren’t available yet. Please try again later.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, quote this code: {requestId}.

myPrompts.title: My prompts
myPrompts.lead: Every prompt, skill and agent you own or co-author, newest first. Each one has a review where you read feedback and push new versions.

liveReview.open: A change is waiting for review.
liveReview.changes_requested: A reviewer asked for changes to your proposed update.
liveReview.approved: The live version is up to date.
liveReview.rejected: Your last proposed change wasn’t approved; the live version stays.
liveReview.withdrawn: Your last proposed change was withdrawn; the live version stays.

delete.label: Delete
delete.question: Delete “{title}” for good?
delete.consequence: Its page, reviews, comments, co-authors, ratings and example images are removed too. This can’t be undone.

errors.unauthenticated: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
errors.forbidden: Only the post’s owner can delete it.
errors.notFound: We couldn’t find that post. Reload the page and try again.
errors.notConfigured: Deleting isn’t available yet. Please try again later.
errors.server: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again in a moment. If it keeps happening, quote this code: {requestId}.
